# Phase 25 — Requirements Baseline

Create a versioned requirements baseline with BR/FR/NFR/CON/OUT IDs, priorities, source/rationale, dependencies, owner, status and measurable acceptance criteria AC IDs. Cover media ingestion/rights, transcription, multimodal discovery, NVIDIA/local GPU routing, editor, rendering, publishing, scheduling, analytics, security/privacy, accessibility, reliability, performance, cost and operations. Identify conflicts and untestable wording. Do not code. Request `APPROVE REQUIREMENTS v1`.
